summary.text: John Sytek is a Republican member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives from Rockingham 25 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election after advancing from the September 8 primary.
Sytek is a teacher, according to Ballotpedia.

paragraphs.text: John Sytek was born in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania.

He earned a degree in physics from St. Joseph's University and a master's degree in nuclear engineering from the Massachusetts Institute of Technology, and his career experience includes working as a teacher.
Ballotpedia lists Sytek's tenure in the New Hampshire House of Representatives as beginning in 2010.
